title: rulecad project
description: A project's own file, projects/<name>/project.json: what it is, the plastic and printer its parts are made for, and its objects. cad new <project> writes it, cad set <project> field=value changes it, cad new <project>/<object> lists each object.

name.description: The project's folder name: lower case, with dashes

title.description: What the project is, in a few words, for its pages and lists

description.description: A sentence or two on what it is for

material.description: The plastic its parts print in unless a part says otherwise: PLA or PETG, or a rule set in rules/ that gives strength, modulus and density. Printed fittings are sized from it

printer.description: The printer rule set its prints are checked against (bed, overhang, layer), as x1c; left out, cad.config.json's printer

objects.description: Its objects, by name, as cad new <project>/<object> lists them

filaments.description: Its filaments, by name, for parts that print in more than one (a part's "filament": "legend"): each in its AMS slot

slot.description: The AMS slot it loads from, 1 to 16

material.description: Its plastic, where it differs from the project's
